verdict.rationale: AutoGen documents a Logging capability to 'log traces and internal messages' (autogen-docs-21), and AutoGen Studio offers an interactive environment for running teams with pause/stop control (autogen-docs-7, autogen-docs-24). Nothing shows per-LLM-call and per-tool-invocation traces surfaced in an observability UI, so the story is only glancingly supported. Missing for 10: evidence of an observability/trace-viewer UI, explicit per-LLM-call and tool-call span capture, integration with tracing backends (e.g. OpenTelemetry), and independent hands-on corroboration.
